unit_label: BRBL::MOD_APPENDIX::U01: Navigate FEMA transaction classification,contravention and appeal routes

payload.title: Classify the transaction before the remedy
payload.core_explanation_md:
For foreign-exchange questions, identify the parties, residence, transaction purpose and current/capital-account category before looking for permission or conditions. An authorised-person duty differs from the customer transaction rule. The Act must be read with the applicable rules, regulations and dated directions.

If a contravention is alleged, distinguish penalty, compounding, adjudication and the relevant appeal. Compounding is not simply another name for an appeal, and a penalty heading alone does not establish the amount or the required process. Keep the transaction date and statutory version attached to the research note.

self_check.prompt_text: Why classify the account transaction first?
self_check.expected_takeaway: The governing permission and conditions depend on the actual category and facts.

payload.stem_md: A file calls compounding and appellate review the same remedy and sends every case through one route. What is needed?

options.text_md: Separate the statutory purpose, authority and conditions of each route
Choose the cheapest route without eligibility analysis
Assume every foreign payment is prohibited
options.explanation_md: That is not the classification method.

payload.stem_md: A transaction is analysed using only a penalty section without deciding its underlying permission or conditions. What should come first?

options.explanation_md: It does not settle legal classification.
That does not establish a contravention.

options.text_md: The applicable transaction rule and dated regulatory framework
options.explanation_md: A sanction requires an identified legal breach.
It does not govern this question.

payload.correct_explanation_md: A sanction requires an identified legal breach.
